question.nlq: Identify all distinguished contributors who satisfy the following criteria: they possess a minimum reputation threshold of at least 1000 points, have authored a minimum of five posts with positive cumulative scores, have submitted a minimum of ten comments with non-negative scores, and have been awarded at least one badge. Calculate their total engagement score using the formula: reputation plus three times the number of posts plus two times the number of comments plus five times the number of distinct badges obtained. Return only those contributors whose engagement score exceeds 1200, ordered by engagement score in descending order.
evidence: Distinguished contributors are defined as users meeting ALL criteria below: (1) Minimum reputation threshold: 1000 points indicates established community presence. (2) Minimum post count: 5 posts shows consistent content contribution. (3) Positive cumulative post scores: sum of Score column must be greater than zero. (4) Minimum comment count: 10 comments indicates active discussion participation. (5) Non-negative comment scores: all comment scores should be >= 0. (6) Minimum badge count: 1 badge indicates some form of recognition. Engagement score formula: reputation + (3 × post_count) + (2 × comment_count) + (5 × DISTINCT badge_count). Minimum engagement score threshold: 1200 points.

User age categories are classified as: teenager (ages 13-18), adult (ages 19-65), elder (ages >65). Post popularity is determined by view count where higher values indicate greater interest. Comment sentiment analysis: scores above 60 represent positive contributions, scores below 60 represent negative contributions. Badge types include teacher, editor, supporter based on the Name column values in badges table.

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH UserPosts AS (
    SELECT 
        OwnerUserId AS UserId,
        COUNT(*) AS post_count,
        SUM(Score) AS total_post_score
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND SUM(Score) > 0
),
UserComments AS (
    SELECT 
        UserId,
        COUNT(*) AS comment_count
    FROM comments
    WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL
      AND Score >= 0
    GROUP BY UserId
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
),
UserBadges AS (
    SELECT 
        UserId,
        COUNT(DISTINCT Id) AS badge_count
    FROM badges
    WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY UserId
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Id) >= 1
)
SELECT 
    u.DisplayName,
    (u.Reputation + 3 * up.post_count + 2 * uc.comment_count + 5 * ub.badge_count) AS engagement_score
FROM users u
INNER JOIN UserPosts up ON u.Id = up.UserId
INNER JOIN UserComments uc ON u.Id = uc.UserId
INNER JOIN UserBadges ub ON u.Id = ub.UserId
WHERE u.Reputation >= 1000
  AND (u.Reputation + 3 * up.post_count + 2 * uc.comment_count + 5 * ub.badge_count) > 1200
ORDER BY engagement_score DESC;

WITH user_posts AS (
  SELECT OwnerUserId AS user_id,
         COUNT(*) AS post_count,
         SUM(COALESCE(Score, 0)) AS post_score_sum
  FROM posts
  GROUP BY OwnerUserId
),
user_comments AS (
  SELECT UserId AS user_id,
         COUNT(*) AS comment_count
  FROM comments
  WHERE Score IS NOT NULL AND Score >= 0
  GROUP BY UserId
),
user_badges AS (
  SELECT UserId AS user_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT Name) AS badge_count
  FROM badges
  GROUP BY UserId
)
SELECT u.Id,
       u.Reputation,
       up.post_count,
       uc.comment_count,
       ub.badge_count,
       (u.Reputation + 3*up.post_count + 2*uc.comment_count + 5*ub.badge_count) AS engagement_score
FROM users u
JOIN user_posts up ON u.Id = up.user_id
JOIN user_comments uc ON u.Id = uc.user_id
JOIN user_badges ub ON u.Id = ub.user_id
WHERE u.Reputation >= 1000
  AND up.post_count >= 5
  AND up.post_score_sum > 0
  AND uc.comment_count >= 10
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.UserId = u.Id AND c.Score < 0)
  AND ub.badge_count >= 1
  AND (u.Reputation + 3*up.post_count + 2*uc.comment_count + 5*ub.badge_count) > 1200
ORDER BY engagement_score DESC;
